# JoeSSH Workbench

JoeSSH is a local-first remote workbench for SSH terminals, SFTP file management, team access control, and session management.

## Features

- [SSH Terminal](/features/terminal) - Multi-tab terminal sessions with command preflight and safety guardrails
- [SFTP Browser](/features/sftp) - File transfer and remote file management
- [Team Access](/features/team) - JIT access, shared vaults, and audit trails
- [Port Forwarding](/features/forwarding) - Local and remote port forwarding
- [Session Recording](/features/recording) - Terminal session recording and playback
